hooks.command: n=KAM; for d in "$PROJECT_NOTES_DIR" "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/../project-notes" "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/../../project-notes" "$HOME/project-notes"; do if [ -n "$d" ] && [ -d "$d/.git" ]; then git -C "$d" pull -q --ff-only 2>/dev/null; cat "$d/standards.md" "$d/$n.md" 2>/dev/null; exit 0; fi; done; echo "WARNING: project-notes was not found (checked \$PROJECT_NOTES_DIR, ../project-notes, ../../project-notes and ~/project-notes), so the standards and the $n handbook were NOT loaded. Tell the owner. Fix: clone https://github.com/thedinz/project-notes.git next to this project, or set PROJECT_NOTES_DIR to where it is."
